nature: P0a documentation fixture anchor for the current D023 ExecutionSpec example only. This is not a runtime implementation test, not a production codec result, and not a claim that execute, assess, or a host has been run.
scope: current-d023-example-only; does not modify or replace fixtures/t108-v4/MANIFEST.json
path_base: paths in files[].file are relative to docs/contracts/

request_digest_landing.definition: request_digest is the literal prefix sha256: followed by the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the complete ExecutionSpec canonical inferrsi-json-v1 bytes (ASCII key order, UTF-8, no BOM, no spaces, no trailing LF). ExecutionSpec itself has no request_digest field.
request_digest_landing.apps_step: When Apps builds an evaluation-mode ExecutionSpec, it copies prepared.recipe.code_sha256 unchanged into every CommandStep.expected_code_sha256. Apps does not invent a digest and does not write request_digest onto the spec.
request_digest_landing.h_step: H, at execute registration/claim time, after the final ExecutionSpec is complete (including V24 seal_generation when a generation_plan InputSpec is added), computes request_digest from those canonical spec bytes and stores it on the attempt row and on ExecutionRecordPayload.request_digest. This P0a PR only records the documentation golden; it does not implement that H path.

files.note: The checked-in file is already canonical, so the file sha256 and the digest body are identical. Independent verification must recompute both from the file bytes.
